name: Wastewater treatment; TSS removal, flat glass industry; at plant
description: This unit process reflects treatment of process wastewater at U.S. flat glass production facilities. The functional unit reflects treatment of 1 cubic meter of wastewater from a relevant facility. The scope of this process (via linked processes) includes basic infrastructure and operational impacts of onsite treatment processes and sludge management and transport to an inert material landfill.
category: 22: Utilities/2213: Water, Sewage and Other Systems

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Upstream unit process LCI data was developed in CAPDETWorks software. Effluent data was estimated based on current (2025) U.S. regulations for the flat glass industry (float production process). Updating background electricity and input data should maintain process relevance so long as the target treatment system matches the defined system.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: The treatment system includes chemically enhanced clarification, dechlorination, sludge dewatering using a hydraulic filter press and hauling dried sludge to an inert material landfill. The process is parameterized with the option to add chlorine disinfection, a multi-media filter, or to replace the lagoon process with a clarifier or chemically enhanced clarifier.
processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: This process was developed to represent wastewater treatment at a generic U.S. flat glass production facility, using the float glass process, where the main pollutants of concern are total suspended solids, phosphorus, and oil. Key insights into water management at flat glass facilities were drawn for U.S. EPA's Effluent Guideline Development Documents (see sources). Underlying unit processes used to develop this wastewater treatment system process were drawn from original LCI research conducted for U.S. EPA (see sources).
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: Mechanical and electrical equipment is outside of the scope of this linked product system. Landfilling of flat glass sludge is modeled using a CUTOFF flow due to the lack of an a suitable available process. Sludge generation was estimated based on a TSS mass balance. Water loss was estimated considering loss during sludge drying and disposal. No other mass balance was performed.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Treatment process configuration was based on review of EPA's effluent guideline development document (see sources) for the flat glass industry. Due to the age of this resource, the prevalence of treatment processes was confirmed with a selective review of recent permit applications and inspection reports. Data for upstream unit processes was selected based on availability of unit process data from prior projects conducted in the water/wastewater sector. Unit processes were selected based on technological applicability and completeness of the developed inventory.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Outputs of the CAPDET model are reported on an annual (energy, chemicals) or lifetime (infrastructure) basis. Annual quantities are standardized to the functional unit by dividing by the average quantity of wastewater treated per year. For inventory data reported on a lifetime basis, quantities are standardized to the functional unit by amortizing the inventory item over the expected lifespan of the infrastructure component.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: The scope of this process includes wastewater treatment processes (chemically enhanced clarifier, dechlorination), sludge management processes (filter press) and release of treated effluent to surfacewater. Basic infrastructure is included (excavation, concrete, steel). Operation of the sewage collection system, infrastructure disposal, and electrical and mechanical equipment are outside of the system boundaries. Selection of applicable treatment process was made based on review of the cited effluent guideline development document and a limited review of facility permit data. Uncertainty data is not included for this process.
processDocumentation.useAdvice: This process reflects the full scope of wastewater treatment for TSS removal in the flat glass industry. The default treatment process is a chemically enhanced clarifier. Change settings on the parameter tab to select a clarifier as an alternate to chemically enhanced clarification or to add a chlorination and/or multi-media filtration processes if desired. Ensure that the exchange values are showing up as desired before running results. If applying this process to another industry, ensure that the selected treatment processes and effluent quality match your study context. Consider creating or editing the existing effluent process if site specific data is available.
processDocumentation.intendedApplication: This process is intended to be used as a background process by LCA practitioners, industry and the general public to reflect the impact of flat glass industry wastewater treatment within their product systems. The inventory should be sufficient to model TRACI 2.1 impact categories.
processDocumentation.projectDescription: This unit process was prepared by Eastern Research Group (ERG) on behalf of the National Renewable Energy Laboratory as part of their Federal LCA Commons curation activities.
